name: Energy
description: How rested you are. Drains as you act; a night's sleep restores it. Fresh down to Exhausted.

name: Focus
description: Your remaining mental bandwidth for the day — how much more you can absorb before your mind is spent. Sharp down to Burnt out.

name: Mana Reserves
description: Your inner reservoir of magic — Brimming down to Empty. Recovers with rest.
